behavior: A click on `Combobox.Label` focuses the control of its root: the input, or the trigger while the input is inside the popup. The id of the trigger element does not matter. Base UI finds the trigger by an id: the control id of the field, or the id of the trigger element with no field. The props of the `render` element win over those of the part, so its `id` replaces the id of the trigger. In a field, the click then focuses nothing when the `render` element has another id than the control id of the field. With no field, it focuses nothing when the `render` element has an empty id.
